overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、国际贸易（1 篇）、劳动经济学（1 篇）。方法上以数值模拟、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（9 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）、OpenAlex（1 篇）。

papers.title: Governing Fair Building Electrification in Australia and California
papers.abstract: Building electrification can reduce emissions by replacing fossil gas, but its effects on households depend on how the transition is managed. This paper compares Australia and California to examine how institutional arrangements affect the equity of the gas-to-electricity transition. The analysis draws on a review of 35 policy, regulatory and academic documents, supplemented by 14 stakeholder consultations undertaken between 2023 and 2025. The consultations were used to test interpretation of the documentary evidence and clarify institutional and implementation issues rather than to provide a representative qualitative dataset. Three areas are examined: planning and institutional coordination, management of declining gas infrastructure, and impacts on household energy costs and participation. Australia’s electricity planning framework provides a basis for least-cost planning, but does not yet provide an explicit framework for retiring distribution gas networks or allocating associated costs. California has substantial climate and energy policy capacity but a more fragmented regulatory system, including federal constraints on local action. The review identifies distributional differences and affordability pressures in both jurisdictions, including higher energy expenditure among Australian renters and substantial electricity tariff increases in California. The comparison suggests three areas for policy attention: considering equity in infrastructure planning, actively managing declining gas networks, and improving coordination between institutions. Building electrification is therefore not only a technology and investment issue but also a question of how infrastructure costs, network decline and household participation are governed.
papers.summary_zh:
【国际贸易】建筑电气化通过替代化石燃料来减少排放，但其对家庭的影响取决于转型过程的管理方式。本文以澳大利亚和加利福尼亚为例，探讨了制度安排如何影响从天然气向电力转型的公平性。分析基于对35份政策、监管和学术文献的梳理，并结合了2023年至2025年间开展的14次利益相关者咨询。这些咨询旨在验证文献资料的解释，并明确制度与实施方面的问题，而非提供具有代表性的定性数据集。研究重点关注三个方面：规划与制度协调、老旧天然气基础设施的管理，以及家庭能源成本和参与度的影响。

澳大利亚的电力规划框架为最低成本规划提供了基础，但尚未建立明确的天然气分配网络退役或相关成本分摊机制。加利福尼亚在气候与能源政策方面具有较强能力，但其监管体系较为分散，尤其是联邦政府对地方行动存在诸多限制。研究指出，两国在能源分配和可负担性方面存在差异：澳大利亚的租户能源支出较高，而加利福尼亚的电力电价涨幅显著。比较结果表明，政策应重点关注三个领域：在基础设施规划中充分考虑公平性、积极管理老旧天然气网络，以及加强各机构之间的协调。因此，建筑电气化不仅是一个技术和投资问题，还涉及基础设施成本、网络老化状况以及家庭参与度的管理方式。。

papers.title: Extending the Oracle Approximating Shrinkage to General Distributions
papers.abstract: The Oracle Approximating Shrinkage (OAS) estimator provides a closed-form, data-driven shrinkage intensity for regularizing sample covariance matrices toward a scaled identity target, but its derivation assumes Gaussian data. In practice, financial returns, neural signals, and many other high-dimensional datasets exhibit heavy tails and non-zero kurtosis, violating this assumption. We extend OAS to any distribution with finite fourth moments by incorporating a correction term $α$ built from the fourth-order joint cumulants of the data. The correction vanishes under Gaussianity, recovering the OAS formula as a special case; it admits a consistent $O(np)$ sample estimator and satisfies $ρ\in [0, 1]$ exactly for both the population cumulant and its sample analogue. Simulations and an equity-returns study confirm that the correction closes the gap between OAS and the Ledoit-Wolf estimator under non-Gaussian data, with OAS-Extended performing comparably across all tested settings. The contribution is a principled correction for OAS practitioners facing heavy-tailed data; structurally, it is distinct from prior work extending Ledoit-Wolf to elliptical distributions, which optimizes against a fixed oracle target and yields a different closed-form formula.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】Oracle近似收缩（OAS）估计器提供了一种封闭形式的、基于数据的收缩强度，用于将样本协方差矩阵规范化为缩放后的单位矩阵目标。然而，其推导过程假设数据服从高斯分布。实际上，金融回报、神经信号以及许多其他高维数据集都表现出厚尾特性和非零峰度，这些特性违反了高斯分布的假设。我们通过引入一个修正项α（该修正项基于数据的四阶联合累积量计算得出），将OAS方法扩展到任何具有有限四阶矩的分布。在高斯分布情况下，该修正项趋于零，此时OAS公式重新得到验证；该方法能够产生一个一致的O(np)阶样本估计量，并且对于总体累积量及其样本对应量，ρ的值始终满足0≤ρ≤1。仿真分析和股票回报研究证实，在非高斯数据环境下，该修正项有效缩小了OAS与Ledoit-Wolf估计器之间的差距；在所有测试设置中，OAS-Extended估计器的表现均较为出色。这一贡献为处理厚尾数据的OAS应用提供了理论上的修正方法。从结构上看，它与以往将Ledoit-Wolf方法扩展到椭圆分布的研究不同——后者是针对固定的“神谕”目标进行优化的，并得出了不同的封闭形式公式。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Momentum, Commentary Tone, and Earnings Surprise in LLM Financial Forecasts
papers.abstract: Which inputs drive a language model's financial forecast? We construct synthetic earnings announcements that independently reverse 20-day momentum, non-informational commentary tone, and whether fixed actual EPS beats a manipulated consensus. Six instruction/chat checkpoint conversions from four families (0.49-7.61B base parameters) receive 2,016 prompts each under a direct-answer Q8_0 protocol. The design includes 24 numerical blocks, six commentary pairs, profits and losses, rising and falling annual EPS, and two surprise sizes. Both A/B answer assignments and U/D cover all 384 primary scenarios per conversion. We estimate matched changes in conditional answer-prefix scores, not calibrated market probabilities. Across these checkpoints, the primary EPS contrast ranges from -0.19 to 86.80 percentage points. The magnitude of the primary signed tone contrast exceeds that of EPS in 5 of six models, and momentum exceeds it in 5. Natural-word numerical diagnostic accuracy ranges from 51.0 to 95.8 percent. Answer-encoding, wording, context, and conversion controls qualify these results. The experiment measures observable input reliance and numerical recognition; it establishes neither an internal reasoning mechanism nor realized return predictability. Public benchmark prompts, recorded scores, and an interactive recorded-results explorer accompany the study.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】哪些输入因素会影响语言模型对财务预测的生成结果？我们构建了合成性的收益公告，这些公告能够独立地改变20天的市场趋势（动量）、评论的语气（是否包含非信息性内容），以及实际每股收益（EPS）是否超出被操纵的市场预期。共有四个不同模型的6个指令/聊天检查点转换版本（基础参数范围为49亿至76.1亿），每个版本在直接回答Q8_0协议下接受了2016个提示。实验设计包含了24个数值数据块、6组评论内容、利润与亏损数据、年度EPS的增减情况，以及两种不同的意外程度（惊喜大小）。无论是A/B类型的答案分配方式还是上升/下降趋势的预测，每个转换版本都涵盖了所有384种主要情景。我们评估的是条件性答案前缀分数的变化情况，而非经过校准的市场概率。在这些检查点中，实际EPS与预期EPS之间的差异范围在-0.19%到86.80%之间。在六个模型中，有五个模型的主要评论语气差异幅度超过了EPS本身的变化幅度；而在五个模型中，市场动量的变化幅度也超过了EPS的变化幅度。自然语言数值内容的诊断准确率介于51.0%到95.8%之间。实验结果的有效性通过答案编码方式、表述方式、上下文信息以及转换控制机制得到了验证...。研究方法：模型校准、实验方法。

papers.title: MECHANISM AND PATH OF CHAIN MASTER ENTERPRISES LEADING THE COLLABORATIVE DEVELOPMENT OF ZHAOQING NEW ENERGY VEHICLE INDUSTRY CHAIN FROM THE PERSPECTIVE OF HETEROGENEITY
papers.venue: Journal of Trends in Finance and Economics
papers.abstract: Against the backdrop of intensifying competition within industrial chains, the industrial organizational capabilities of anchor enterprises have become pivotal in shaping regional industrial networks. Anchor enterprises positioned at different nodes of the value chain exhibit markedly distinct industrial driving logics. This study selects XPeng Motors' Zhaoqing production base and Ruiqing Times as comparative cases to analyze, from a heterogeneity perspective, the differentiated industrial driving logics—and their respective regional synergistic effects—of vehicle manufacturing anchor enterprises versus core-component anchor enterprises. The research finds that vehicle manufacturing anchor enterprises establish a "demand–order-driven" mechanism, leveraging vehicle production, market orders, and supplier networks to generate supporting demand upstream in the industrial chain; whereas core-component anchor enterprises establish a "technology–product-driven" mechanism, relying on core power battery technologies and scalable production capacities to catalyze industrial agglomeration across the battery supply chain. The mere establishment and clustering of anchor enterprises does not automatically yield industrial chain synergy; instead, the regional industrial environment, industrial park infrastructure, and industrial support services constitute critical supporting conditions for the regionalization of the anchor enterprise effect, thereby influencing the transformation of enterprise-level industrial driving effects into regional industrial organizational capabilities. Within a dual-chain parallel configuration, challenges such as insufficient capabilities among supporting enterprises, weak cross-chain linkages, limited shared services, and the absence of collaborative mechanisms constrain the upgrading of industrial networks. Accordingly, this study proposes actionable pathways—including enhancing the capabilities of anchor enterprises, fostering the competencies of supporting entities, constructing cross-chain network architectures, and refining collaborative mechanisms-to guide regional industrial networks from a dual-chain parallel state toward dual-chain coupling.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】在产业链竞争日益激烈的背景下，核心企业的产业组织能力已成为塑造区域产业网络的关键因素。位于价值链不同节点的核心企业展现出截然不同的产业驱动逻辑。本研究以小鹏汽车的肇庆生产基地和瑞庆时代为例，从异质性的角度分析了汽车制造核心企业与核心零部件核心企业在产业驱动逻辑及区域协同效应方面的差异。研究发现，汽车制造核心企业采用“需求-订单驱动”机制，通过汽车生产、市场订单和供应商网络来带动产业链上游的需求；而核心零部件核心企业则依靠核心动力电池技术和可扩展的生产能力来促进整个电池供应链的产业集聚。核心企业的形成与集聚本身并不能自动产生产业链协同效应，区域产业环境、工业园区基础设施和产业支持服务才是实现核心企业效应区域化的重要条件，这些因素影响着企业层面的产业驱动效应向区域产业组织能力的转化。在双链并行配置的背景下，支持企业能力不足、跨链联动薄弱、共享服务有限以及缺乏协作机制等问题制约了产业网络的升级。因此，本研究提出了若干可行路径，包括提升核心企业能力、培育支持实体竞争力、构建跨链网络架构以及完善协作机制，以推动区域产业网络从双链并行状态向双链耦合状态发展。。

papers.title: Compliance without Commitment? Mandatory ESG Reporting on the Mongolian Stock Exchange
papers.venue: Journal of Economics, Finance and Accounting Studies
papers.abstract: Stock exchanges in frontier markets increasingly require listed companies to publish environmental, social and governance (ESG) reports, yet little is known about whether such rules change how many firms report, when they report and what they file. This study evaluates the rule of the Mongolian Stock Exchange that, from October 2024, made annual ESG reporting mandatory for issuers in its top listing tier (Tier I) and left it voluntary in Tiers II and III. Using only public exchange records, we reconstruct each issuer's tier at every reporting deadline from the exchange's tier notices and date all 99 documents in its ESG registry, which yields 668 firm-years for 176 listed equities over the financial years 2022–2025. Difference-in-differences estimates with firm and year fixed effects, bias-reduced cluster-robust and wild cluster bootstrap inference show that the mandate raised the probability that a Tier I issuer posted an ESG report within five months of the deadline by 46 percentage points and the probability of posting by the 30 April deadline by 25 points. Tier I reporting was already rising before the rule, but among issuers that had never reported, the annual rate of starting rose from 26% to 78% in Tier I and from 1% to 3% elsewhere. Reporting followed the obligation rather than a commitment: two issuers moved out of Tier I in September 2025 stopped reporting, two moved into it started, and after the rule non-mandated issuers followed a report with another in only 5 of 11 cases, against 32 of 33 cases among mandated issuers. Compliance was partial and thin. Only 53% of mandated firm-years met the deadline, first reports produced under the mandate were shorter than those of earlier reporters (median 7 against 10 pages) and less often on time, about half of the posted documents are scanned images without machine-readable text, and six are in English. A tier-based mandate closed most of the reporting gap within two years, but exchanges need enforced deadlines and data standards to turn filings into information investors can use.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】前沿市场的证券交易所日益要求上市公司发布环境、社会和治理（ESG）报告，然而关于这些规定是否改变了公司的报告数量、报告时间以及报告内容，目前仍知之甚少。本研究评估了蒙古证券交易所的一项规定：自2024年10月起，该交易所要求其顶级上市板块（一级市场）的发行人必须每年提交ESG报告，而二级和三级市场的发行人则可选择自愿提交。我们仅利用交易所公开的记录，通过分析各发行人的等级变更通知以及其ESG报告库中的所有99份文件，重建了2022至2025财年期间176家上市公司的等级变化情况。采用差异-in-differences模型（控制公司和年份固定效应）、偏差校正的群组稳健估计方法以及野生群组自助法（wild cluster bootstrap）进行数据分析后发现，这一强制规定使得一级市场发行人在报告截止日期前五个月内发布ESG报告的概率提高了46个百分点，而在4月30日截止日期前发布报告的概率提高了25个百分点。在规则实施之前，一级市场的报告率就已经有所上升；在之前从未发布过报告的发行人中，一级市场的年度报告启动率从26%上升至78%，其他市场则从1%上升至3%。这些公司的报告行为更多...。研究方法：双重差分、固定效应。

papers.title: Partial Localization and Multifractality in Heterogeneous Population Growth with Resetting
papers.abstract: We study a model of heterogeneous multiplicative growth with mean-field redistribution and independent local stochastic resetting. The model describes populations or wealth distributed over sites with quenched growth-rate heterogeneity, while resets represent random local extinction or bankruptcy events. At large redistribution or resetting rate, we find a delocalized phase and we compute the growth rate as well as the stationary distribution of the population of a given site. We show that reset-free growth episodes generate power-law stationary tails with site-dependent exponents. For weak resetting and redistribution, favorable sites can undergo long reset-free episodes and localize. This produces a partially localized phase, in which a finite fraction of the total population is carried by a small set of sites whose identity changes on an $O(1)$ time scale within a subextensive pool of $N^{u^\star}$ favorable candidates, with $0<u^\star<1$. We derive the corresponding growth rate from a saddle point analysis, and show that the averaged stationary fractions display multifractal behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了一个具有平均场重分布机制和独立局部随机重置机制的异质性乘性增长模型。该模型描述了分布在不同位置上的种群或财富，这些位置的增长率存在异质性；而重置事件则代表随机发生的局部灭绝或破产现象。在重分布或重置率较高的情况下，系统会进入一个非局部化阶段，我们计算了该模型中特定位置的增长率及其稳态分布。研究发现，在没有重置的情况下，种群的增长过程会产生具有位置依赖性指数的幂律分布。当重置和重分布的强度较低时，优势位置可能会经历较长的无重置期并逐渐局部化，从而形成部分局部化阶段——此时总种群中的一部分集中在少数几个位置上，这些位置的身份会在$O(1)$的时间尺度内发生变化，这些位置属于一个规模为$N^{u^\star}$的优势候选集合（其中$0<u^\star<1$）。我们通过鞍点分析推导出了相应的增长率，并发现平均稳态分布具有多重分形特性。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Designing Experiments for External Decision Makers
papers.abstract: Standard Bayesian experimental design (BED) methods assume the experimenter alone will act on the data, choosing the best action given their own beliefs and goals. In practice, data are often acted on by external parties whose procedures the experimenter cannot change and may not know, particularly when the data are released publicly. To extend BED to such settings, we introduce usage-aware experimental design, a framework in which an adaptive design policy is trained to minimise the usage risk: the experimenter's expected loss when one or more external rules act on the collected data. These rules may be non-Bayesian or black-box, and when several may apply, we either average over them or take the worst case. We show that, unlike in standard BED, more informative data can be harmful under such rules, so the usage risk cannot in general be expressed as an expected uncertainty reduction; our framework thus strictly generalises standard BED. We then use it to tackle a range of problems that are difficult to address with existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】标准的贝叶斯实验设计（Standard Bayesian Experimental Design, BED）方法假设实验者将独自处理数据，并根据自身的信念和目标选择最佳行动方案。然而在现实中，数据往往会被外部机构或个人使用，而这些机构的操作流程实验者无法更改，也可能并不了解，尤其是在数据被公开发布的情况下。为了将BED方法扩展到这类场景中，我们提出了“基于数据使用情况的实验设计”（Usage-Aware Experimental Design）框架。该框架通过训练一种自适应设计策略来最小化数据使用带来的风险——即当一个或多个外部机构对收集到的数据进行处理时，实验者所预期的损失。这些外部机构的操作可能并不遵循贝叶斯原理，或者属于“黑箱”类型（即其内部机制对实验者透明）。当存在多个可能影响数据使用的规则时，我们可以对这些规则进行平均处理，或者选择最糟糕的情况作为评估依据。研究表明，与标准BED方法不同，在这种环境下，更具信息量的数据反而可能带来负面影响；因此，数据使用风险通常无法简单地用“预期的不确定性降低”来表示。我们的框架严格扩展了标准BED方法的应用范围。随后，我们利用这一框架...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、实验方法。

papers.title: Algorithmic Collusion Without Deterrence: Auditing the Punishment Mechanism in Q-Learning Pricing Agents
papers.abstract: Independent tabular Q-learning agents repricing in a simulated Bertrand duopoly converge to supracompetitive prices, and the seminal evidence attributes this to a learned reward-punishment scheme: undercut your rival and it retaliates, so deviation never pays. This mechanistic reading is what turns high prices into a cartel, and into a regulatory target. We replicate the environment of Calvano et al. (2020) and confirm their impulse-response pattern within co-trained pairs. We then audit the pattern on frozen policies, with learning off, and find that on its own it does not identify a mechanism: the return is over-determined rather than selective. In nine of ten converged pairs (914 of 1,024) a single attractor's basin is the entire state space, so every perturbation returns whatever provoked it, and a forced price increase triggers the same retaliatory pattern as an undercut. What co-training produces is a narrow, dyad-specific basin of attraction: re-match frozen agents from independent runs, as Calvano et al. did with learning on, and coordination collapses by 80% with nothing carried across. The deterrence claim is incomplete on its own terms: the one-period undercut of Calvano et al.'s impulse-response test is unprofitable, which we confirm in 92% of pairs, but the optimal deviation, computed by dynamic programming against each partner's frozen strategy, profits by 17.5% on average. The scheme deters only the deviation no optimizer would choose; collusion survives because deviation is never tried, not because it would not pay. Supracompetitive prices are robust; the punishment mechanism read into them does not survive these tests, which changes what the standard test of algorithmic collusion establishes, and what pairing-disruption remedies can be expected to do.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在模拟的Bertrand双头垄断市场中，独立运行的Q学习代理通过重新定价逐渐形成超竞争性价格。这一现象的主要解释是它们学习到了一种奖励与惩罚机制：如果低价竞争对手，对方会进行报复，因此任何偏离策略的行为都不会带来收益。正是这种机制使得高价行为演变为卡特尔行为，并成为监管的重点。我们复制了Calvano等人（2020年）的研究环境，验证了他们在共同训练的代理对之间观察到的冲动-反应模式。随后，我们在关闭学习功能的情况下再次测试该模式，发现仅凭这一机制无法揭示具体的行为机制——系统的响应行为更多是随机的而非有选择性的。在1024对代理对中，有914对（占90%）的整个状态空间都受单一吸引子的控制，这意味着任何扰动都会导致系统恢复到最初的状态；强制提价同样会引发与低价竞争相同的报复行为。而共同训练则形成了一个特定于代理对之间的狭窄吸引子区域：当重新匹配来自不同实验的代理对时，这种协调性会下降80%。仅从机制本身来看，其威慑效果并不充分：Calvano实验中的单期低价竞争行为是无利可图的（我们在92%的样本中验证了这一点），但通过动态规划针对每个对手的固定策略计算出的最优偏离策略平均能带...。

papers.title: Where Backtests and Live Trading Part Ways: Six Defects from One Intraday System
papers.abstract: Backtests of intraday strategies can drift away from what the live system actually does; in our case, the drift never showed in summary statistics. We report six defects found while running one intraday US equity system live and comparing its live days with their backtest replay. Three came from data: a default feed that carried a small fraction of real opening volume, historical prices adjusted for dividends that live orders never see, and data the live system downloaded but the backtest never did. Two came from code: a sizing step that exceeded a limit the live account enforces, and UTC timestamps read as New York time. One came from configuration: settings that were switched on but never reached the code that places orders. For each we give the symptom, the size of the error, the cause and the test or control that now guards against it. All six sat where two paths that should agree had drifted apart. We close with a ten-point checklist. We make no claim about whether the system is profitable.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】对日内交易策略进行的回测结果可能会与实际运行系统的表现存在偏差；在我们的案例中，这种偏差并未体现在汇总统计数据中。我们在实际运行一个美国股票交易系统并将其实时交易数据与回测结果进行对比时发现了六个问题。其中三个问题出在数据方面：一是数据源存在缺陷，仅提供了少量真实的开盘成交量；二是历史价格数据经过了股息调整，但实际交易中并未体现这些股息调整；三是实际系统下载了某些数据，而回测程序并未下载这些数据。另外三个问题出在代码实现上：一是订单规模调整步骤超出了实际账户所设定的限制；二是时间戳被错误地解析为纽约时间（而非协调世界时）；三是某些配置选项虽然被启用，但并未被传递到负责下达订单的代码中。对于每一个问题，我们都详细说明了其表现形式、误差大小、产生原因以及目前已采取的预防措施。所有这些问题都源于两个本应保持一致的数据路径出现了差异。最后，我们提供了一份包含十项检查点的清单。我们需要强调的是，我们并不对这套交易系统的盈利能力做出任何评价。。

papers.title: Feeling the generalised rough SABR boundary
papers.abstract: We provide an in-depth analysis of a generalised rough version of the SABR volatility model, widely used in the financial industry. We specifically focus on its behaviour at the origin, whether it can reach it and how fast it may do so.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们对SABR波动率模型的一个广义粗糙版本进行了深入分析，该模型在金融行业中被广泛使用。我们特别关注该模型在原点处的行为，即它是否能够到达原点，以及到达原点的速度有多快。。

papers.title: Locally Robust Inference with Outcomes Predicted by Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Many parameters of interest in economics depend on outcomes generated by machine learning (ML).These generated outcomes are subsequently used in standard econometric estimation and typically treated as observed, a practice that threatens the validity of downstream inference. Empirically relevant cases include dynamic treatment effects under sequential exogeneity, long-term effects with surrogates, the partially linear model with an ML-predicted outcome, productivity persistence with an unrestricted production function and constructed instruments, and outcomes residualized of confounding variation. This paper develops a three-step locally robust GMM framework for valid inference when the dependent variable is generated by ML. We construct a debiased moment condition that augments the identifying moment with first- and second-step influence functions, making inference on the parameter of interest locally insensitive to regularization and model selection biases at both steps. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimator and illustrate its finite-sample performance through Monte Carlo simulations. We also apply the method to U.S. mortgage data to study conditional Black--White disparities in a race-blind ML default-risk score. The score predicts subsequent default well overall, but the conditional disparity embedded in the score is much smaller than the corresponding disparity in realized serious delinquency; accounting for first-step estimation also raises the naive out-of-sample estimate of the score disparity.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】经济学中许多感兴趣的参数都依赖于机器学习（ML）所产生的结果。这些结果随后被用于标准的计量经济学估计中，并通常被视为观测数据，这种做法会威胁到后续推断的有效性。具有实证意义的应用场景包括：在序列外生性条件下的动态处理效应、使用替代变量分析的长期效应、以ML预测结果为基础的偏线性模型、在不受限制的生产函数和构建的工具变量下研究生产率的持续性，以及剔除混杂变量后的结果。本文提出了一种三步局部稳健的广义矩估计（GMM）框架，用于在因变量由ML生成的情况下进行有效的推断。我们构建了一个去偏的矩条件，该条件通过引入第一步和第二步的影响函数，使得对感兴趣参数的推断在局部上不受正则化和模型选择偏差的影响。我们证明了所提出估计量的一致性和渐近正态性，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了其有限样本下的表现。此外，我们还将该方法应用于美国抵押贷款数据，以研究在种族信息被忽略的ML违约风险评分中存在的条件性黑人与白人之间的差异。该评分总体上能够较好地预测后续违约情况，但评分中蕴含的条件性差异实际上远小于实际严重违约情况中的差异；考虑第一步估计过程后，样本外对评分差异的简单估计也会被高估。。研究方法：广义矩估计、蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟、机器学习。

papers.title: When Does "Post-Call" Begin? An Availability Contract for Earnings-Call NLP Benchmarks
papers.abstract: Corporate financial disclosures often unfold over time, with announcements, prepared remarks, and discussion spanning multiple high-frequency return intervals. Financial NLP benchmarks can therefore suffer from a within-event timing mismatch when the prediction target begins before the textual or audio input used by a model could be complete. Chronological train--test splits do not prevent this mismatch, because it occurs inside individual events rather than across samples. We introduce an Availability Contract, which requires a benchmark to state the input boundary, evidence for input availability, the outcome start, and the claims supported by that evidence. We apply this framework to 552 earnings calls from 24 firms. For each call, we hold the return endpoint fixed and compare the previous close, a documentary call-start proxy, and a completion proxy based on reconstructed audio end plus a stipulated processing allowance. At this baseline, moving from the call-start proxy to the completion proxy flips return signs for 9.4% of calls. Holding completion-clock cutpoints fixed, 28.3% change quintile. In an independent release-session analysis of a public earnings-call volatility benchmark, shifting before-market target windows forward by one trading session raises three-day mean squared error by 18.1-21.4% across four frozen prediction streams, while their point rankings remain unchanged. Together, the results show that labels and losses can depend materially on the declared outcome clock even when model rankings appear stable. The Availability Contract makes this assumption explicit and ties post-input claims to the available timing evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】企业财务信息披露通常是一个渐进的过程，相关的公告、准备好的发言以及讨论内容会分布在多个高频收益区间内。因此，当预测目标在模型使用的文本或音频输入完成之前就已确定时，财务自然语言处理（Financial NLP）基准测试可能会出现“事件内部时间不匹配”的问题。按照时间顺序划分训练集和测试集并不能解决这一问题，因为这种时间不匹配发生在单个事件的内部，而非样本之间。我们提出了一种“可用性契约”（Availability Contract），要求基准测试明确说明输入数据的截止时间、输入数据可用的证据、结果开始的时间点，以及这些证据所支持的具体结论。我们将这一框架应用于24家公司的552次财报电话会议数据。对于每次电话会议，我们固定收益的结束时间点，并比较以下三种指标：之前的收盘价、作为电话会议开始时间的代理指标，以及基于重新构建的音频内容加上规定的处理时间后的完成时间点。在这一基准测试下，从电话会议开始时间的代理指标转换到完成时间的代理指标会导致9.4%的会议收益方向发生反转；当固定完成时间的截止点时，这一比例上升至28.3%。在对一个公开财报电话会议波动性基准测试的独立分析中，将市场开...。研究方法：自然语言处理。
